Device..description: The top-level object for a Device.

Device.DeviceInfo..description: This object contains general device information.

{BBF_VENDOR_PREFIX}BaseMACAddress.description: The MAC Address of the device.

Device.DeviceInfo.NetworkProperties..description: This object defines the parameters that describe how the device handles network traffic.

{BBF_VENDOR_PREFIX}ActiveConnections.description: Number of currently active network connections.

{BBF_VENDOR_PREFIX}MaxConnections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous network connections supported.

Device.DeviceInfo.ProcessStatus..description: Status of the processes on the device.

{BBF_VENDOR_PREFIX}MaxProcessEntries.description: Maximum number of process entries that can be reported by the device.

{BBF_VENDOR_PREFIX}ProcessCurrentSorting.description: Current sorting method used for listing process entries (e.g., PID, Memory, CPU_Time).

{BBF_VENDOR_PREFIX}ProcessSupportedSorti.description: <<list>> List items indicate the supported process sorting methods.

Device.DeviceInfo.{BBF_VENDOR_PREFIX}Fil.description: Object providing file descriptor usage statistics.

MaxAllowed.description: Maximum number of file descriptors allowed by the system.

Used.description: Number of file descriptors currently in use.
